tok 1.0 "Farming Bot"

pool bot "Farming Bot"
  lane player "Player"
    start wants "Player wants a custom farming bot"
    task choose "Choose the resources you want"
    and prefs
    task urgency "Set how urgently each resource is needed"
    task deps "Define the tool dependencies between resources"
    and collected
    or orsplit
    task brag "Brag to selected friends"
    task send "Send materials to selected friends"
    or orjoin
    end done "Bot finished"
  lane bot "Farming bot"
    task startfarm "Start farming"
    and farmfork
    task farm "Farm the resources"
    xor disaster "Natural disaster strikes?"
    task setback "Set the bot back"
    task notify "Notify the player when milestones are reached"
    and farmdone
    eventsub updates "Update the list of materials to farm"
      start updreq "Update requested" message="Update materials list"
      task upd "Update the list of materials to farm"
      end updated "List updated"

flow wants -> choose -> prefs
flow prefs -> urgency -> collected
flow prefs -> deps -> collected
flow collected -> startfarm -> farmfork
flow farmfork -> farm -> disaster
flow farmfork -> notify -> farmdone
flow disaster -> setback "yes" -> farm
flow disaster -> farmdone "no"
flow farmdone -> orsplit
flow orsplit -> brag -> orjoin
flow orsplit -> send -> orjoin
flow orjoin -> done
